summary: Oct26 continued source-read V3.0 research maintenance: add Token-World p142, PaceVLA p143 and SPAR p144, with 10 substantial original-text sections each, primary arXiv v1 source locations and explicit negative results. Twenty author-reported/cited-baseline evidence records across 7 separate paper-scoped metrics: Token-World RoboTwin feature/action cosines (not SR), PaceVLA RoboCasa and LIBERO and ALLEX real SR with task-time/throughput excluded, SPAR standard LIBERO vs LIBERO-Plus PAT/PPO recovery (Jetson latency distinct). Token-World author GitHub explicitly placeholder, not released policy code; official project links only. Additional source-checked bilingual Chinese MIIT government briefing distinguishes 2026 half-year output from full-year forecast. OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar date-scoped full-window indexing and IEEE publisher DOI remain unresolved, so no completeness checkpoint is advanced. Real ALLEX report is case-study, not official benchmark. Existing all 141 papers and historical results preserved.

tracks.name: Token-World v1 · RoboTwin 50-task frozen VLM feature fidelity
tracks.tasks: 50 tasks, 100 trajectories/task, 50 success and 50 failure per task
tracks.protocol: Predicted compact-state-decoded VLM feature versus ground-truth frozen Qwen3-VL feature under fixed action replay. Different from task success rate; same 50 tasks and 9:1 split across simulators.
tracks.trainingRegime: 5000 RoboTwin trajectories: 50 success + 50 failure per task, 9:1 train-val; RGB-generating comparators are re-encoded with identical frozen VLM.

tracks.name: Token-World v1 · RoboTwin frozen policy action consistency
tracks.version: RoboTwin 50-task source v1 Table I, fixed downstream policy
tracks.metric: Fixed policy output action cosine similarity
tracks.protocol: Frozen policy actions inferred from predicted VLM-feature representation compared with same frozen policy from ground-truth VLM features. This is a continuous similarity, not task success rate.
tracks.trainingRegime: Same RoboTwin 5000 trajectories and reference-policy evaluation; no re-training of frozen downstream policy in the metric.

tracks.name: PaceVLA v1 · RoboCasa-Kitchen RLDX-1-IMG source table
tracks.split: PnP vs other kitchen task groups
tracks.protocol: RLDX-1-IMG author comparison on 24 RoboCasa-Kitchen tasks with 300 demonstrations/task; PnP and Others group success separately. Reached/failed step horizon and controller tuning from original study. No official RoboCasa leaderboard claim.
tracks.trainingRegime: RLDX-1-IMG backbone; 300 demonstrations per RoboCasa-Kitchen task; PaceVLA decoder/judge/router plus controller setup.

tracks.name: PaceVLA v1 · RLDX standard LIBERO short vs long
tracks.split: Short is mean of Spatial, Object, Goal; Long is LIBERO-Long
tracks.protocol: RLDX-1-IMG source paper Table 1; Short represents three suites, Long the fourth; only group averages shown. Does not reconstruct missing suite values.
tracks.trainingRegime: RLDX-1-IMG flow matching backbone with and without PaceVLA adaptive temporal action modes; fine tuning and control as source.

tracks.name: PaceVLA · ALLEX humanoid conveyor package handling
tracks.tasks: 1 humanoid 15-DoF-hand task, 10 packages in each trial
tracks.split: Real ALLEX long-horizon conveyor package handling
tracks.protocol: Author ALLEX single real-humanoid conveyor task; 10 packages/trial, success percentage separately from packages/min throughput. Not a standard common public leaderboard or simulated RoboCasa SR.
tracks.trainingRegime: GR00T N1.5 base vs adapted PaceVLA, 15-DoF dexterous hands; exact training episodes not specified in this aggregated table.

tracks.name: SPAR v1 · LIBERO 10% hidden / 10% FFN pruning and PPO recovery
tracks.split: Original LIBERO four-suite success under shared author setup
tracks.protocol: Four standard LIBERO suites, π₀.₅ baseline and baseline+RL versus dual structural ρhid=0.1 ρint=0.1 PAT-only/PAT+RL; baseline/PAT stages have different training and must remain explicit.
tracks.trainingRegime: π₀.₅ 3.37B baseline or SPAR 1.12B total (0.09B LLM), PAT pruning+SFT and optional PPO RLinf rollout; record exact recipe in each result.

tracks.name: SPAR v1 · LIBERO-Plus OOD same-checkpoint robustness
tracks.protocol: Same checkpoints as standard LIBERO, evaluated across LIBERO-Plus seven perturbation groups; Overall aggregate only entered, not inferred individual missing metrics. Separate from standard LIBERO success.
tracks.trainingRegime: π₀.₅ original and ρhid=0.1 ρint=0.1 structured PAT pruning with or without PPO recovery; equivalent checkpoints to Table II.
